title: ESL level E1: English as a second language

questions.q: In "Hello and me Remember", which of these is a key idea?
o: Step 1, Plan the talk in four short parts: greeting, name and age, family, likes. Reason: four small parts are easy to remember and give the talk a clear order.
Use it: name animals and body parts and say what they can do, first with help, then alone.
Listen first: your teacher or a recording says the new words or sentences from 'Review and showcase' twice. You repeat them aloud.
Notice the pattern: find where the new sound, word form or sentence rule appears in a short text and mark it.

o: Use it: greet people, give my name and age and spell my name, first with help, then alone.

Use it: say numbers to 20 and name colours and shapes, first with help, then alone.
Use it: present a short talk about myself, first with help, then alone.

questions.q: In "My family and my home Remember", which of these is a key idea?
o: Use it: say numbers to 20 and name colours and shapes, first with help, then alone.

questions.q: In "School things and classroom language Remember", which of these is a key idea?
o: Step 7, Your turn. Listen to this and answer: "This is my friend. She is ten. She likes books." What does she like? Model answer: "She likes books."
Use it: name animals and body parts and say what they can do, first with help, then alone.
Use it: name school objects and follow classroom instructions, first with help, then alone.
Use it: name family members and rooms in a house, first with help, then alone.
